files.note: female hero covered in teal blob slimes, 64x64 RGBA

how_made: Imagine text-to-image of a right-facing female fantasy hero with teal blob slimes. Keyed hot-pink, nearest-neighbour to 64x64, 23-color palette. Text source is committed via GitHub connector; PNG is built by .github/workflows/build-hero-slime-png.yml because the connector cannot store raw PNG bytes.
self_check: decode.py writes a 64x64 RGBA PNG. GitHub Actions commits that file to deliver/0002-smoke-slime/r3/hero-slime.png.
